content.description: The Great Seal of the State of North Carolina is a circular emblem featuring two female figures: Liberty, standing and holding a staff with a liberty cap, and Plenty, seated and holding a cornucopia. The seal includes the dates May 20, 1775, and April 12, 1776, along with the state motto, "Esse Quam Videri," encircled by the text, "The Great Seal of the State of North Carolina."
